credits: Original pixel art for Verdant Reach, hand-pixelled in tools/art/crystal/pitcher.py. Drawn under the Crystal rule (docs/CREATURES.md); no sprite from any other game was copied, traced or imported.
notes: Crystal rule. REARING: a brood of three; the lead trumpet rears in an S over the tussock, its white hood flared. Gesture: the lid creaks up, flares wide (held, nectar glinting), claps down, bounces once and settles. Sport: the anthocyanin-free green form.
